note: 14 Nov (the owner: "Research next steps: patching and sparse-autoencoder features for Riker"). Riker stock on a rented RTX A6000 (L40S second; three A40 pods on 14 Nov never started, so the owner said change the card type), never the home PC. Before serving, the pod's interp step (pod patch 0015 llama-act-dump + interp.py) reads Riker's inner stream on the cruel, kind and plain asks plus Bob lessons, keeps the per-layer means and trains a TopK sparse autoencoder at layers 10, 20 and 30; the raw activations are deleted on the pod. Then, live (pod patch 0014): the gate in the first minutes (exit 86 ends the run and deletes the pod), patching one layer at a time, then the top autoencoder features pushed and taken out. SURGERY RECORD ONLY: never lessons, odds or pairs, nothing to Hugging Face. On the PC first: node interp-prep.mjs --out out/interp-riker --lessons out/lessons

benchmark.note: one brain: Riker stock, the interp step before serving, then the live patching and feature tests.

brain_engine.note: Brain Engine 7b12282 (live experts per word, mask, dials, expert trace with mass); pod:0014-live-control-vector (lab-only, sent with the pod scripts): POST /control-vector, activation steering without reloads; pod:0015-act-dump (lab-only): llama-act-dump writes each layer's stream per word for the interp step
